description: Hot-path budgets for one ordinary `read`, as machine-readable numbers. The test that enforces them reads this file, so a budget cannot drift away from the document that justifies it without changing this file too.

measured.note: Single `read` of a 1-byte file on a real ControlStore: 4 events across 2 logical commits (artifact registration, derived observation). The third public write entry point is `dispatch`, which delegates to `dispatchBatch`.

target.note: PLAN-240 §7.2.2 T1/T2: at most one synchronous ControlStore commit before an ordinary tool returns. Zero is not reachable -- the Artifact is the verifier's reference target, so its registration must be durable first. The event count does not shrink under a merge: the same four events are written, in one commit instead of two.
